graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.edge_density: <float> Fraction of all possible edges that are present in the graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], length num_edges> Pairs of vertices connected by an edge, where each pair contains two distinct vertex indices.

bounds.clique_lower_bound: <int> Largest clique size found in the graph, serving as a lower bound on the number of colors needed.
bounds.greedy_upper_bound: <int> Number of colors used by a greedy heuristic coloring, serving as an upper bound on the number of colors needed.
